description: This course allows students to develop skills for independent research in statistics, probability and related fields, and the application of novel data-driven strategies for solving scientific and business problems. Upon completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate an appreciation of the current state of knowledge in a particular field of research, master the techniques required for the study of a research question, and communicate research findings clearly and concisely in written and spoken English.
